title: ENG 1(2) FAIL

alert.trigger: Engine core speed below idle with the ENG MASTER lever ON and the ENG FIRE pb not pushed.

effectivity.note: ENG 1(2) FAIL and ENG 1(2) SHUT DOWN: one version for all HS-TX.

summary: An engine fails after V1 (or at go-around). Below 400 ft the PF only flies: rudder to centre the beta target, 12.5° then SRS, gear up. At 400 ft the PF orders ECAM ACTIONS until the engine is secured, then calls STOP ECAM to level off at EO acceleration altitude, clean up and set MCT at green dot. CONTINUE ECAM takes the PM to the STATUS page, where the PF stops the ECAM again for the after-takeoff flow and a relight decision.

background.text: Flameout causes include fuel starvation, volcanic ash/sand, heavy rain/hail/icing, bird strike, engine stall, control malfunction.
Suspect damage with two or more of: EGT above red line, rotor speed mismatch or no rotation, vibration/buffet, abnormal oil pressure/temperature, hydraulic loss, repeated stalls.
Takeoff with an engine failure: the blue beta target replaces the sideslip index; lateral normal law gives some rudder, the pilot completes it to centre the target.
When an engine failure is detected the FMGS gives engine-out predictions and deletes pre-selected speeds.

technique.text: Aircraft handling first: stabilise pitch, speed and path before the ECAM.
Failure above V2: keep the SRS attitude; minimum speed V2.
"Secure the engine" = ENG MASTER OFF (no damage), AGENT 1 DISCH (damage), fire out or AGENT 2 DISCH (fire).
With AP engaged the rudder trim is managed by the AP; release rudder pedal pressure.
Do not exceed the EO maximum acceleration altitude if acceleration is delayed.
In cruise: MCT, A/THR off, set heading, standard strategy M.78/300 kt, descend to EO recovery altitude, never below green dot.

gaps.text: Thrust-malfunction and on-ground branches of ENG FAIL are not shown in the flow; this brief covers the in-flight case.

Callout wording differs slightly between sources: FCOM "ECAM ACTION" / "ECAM ACTIONS COMPLETE" vs PDP and FCTM "ECAM ACTIONS" / "ECAM ACTIONS COMPLETED". The PDP is a generic Airbus tutorial; FCOM wording is shown where both exist.
HS-TO-only versions omitted (FCOM P 87–89 and P 174–183/226).
